author: go0by
body:
For those of you who enjoy rushing and mining the monument (such as myself) there was a sort of known trick called the "Boat Trick" (I won't explain it) that aided in getting to the monument if you built a sky bridge. 

The trick only works if you are able to place a boat on solid blocks (not water). I used to use this trick all the time, but ever since some update between June 2015 - May 2016, the feature was removed, now you can't place boats on blocks..

What I think should be changed:
- The ability to place boats on blocks other than water should be reintroduced.

Why:
- It adds a lot more variety to rushing play. Also, it allows for skybridges on most maps with wood to get to the monument without harm. It really helps a lot of rushers too, on maps that are to small to build an underground bridge/ tunnel or just run to the monument.

It used to be in Avicus, but then they removed. Bringing it back would be great. Now all I can use is the Minecart trick which is more tedious and requires iron.

replies.body:
"Bridges are overpowered by themselves, ..."

Really? You can shoot someone off of a bridge and they can't do anything about it. If they skybridge, you can just build your own skybridge and counter it (really not that hard.) If it is a big bridge with sides and can't be knocked off of, you need to build one, too. Or just make a good defense. Bridges are not OP, that's a ridiculous thing to say.

Also, I don't think they should update to 1.9/1.10 as the 1.9 PvP is soooo bad with that Hit Cooldown. Avicus fights will be so lame.
